lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.17-19 - A. Listen. Then act it out.

details: Listen and act checks understanding of the story and builds confidence using the target structures.
Look for careful listening, confident repetition and clear pronunciation.
“I just saw Minh  and she was having a really bad day. Let’s find out why!”

Heads Up (Reading): 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and help Ss to understand the text by asking questions, practicing skimming (reading for gist), scanning (reading for specific information) and detail (reading for comprehension). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down (Listen and Follow): 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together (Video, then act it out): 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.17-19 - B. Choose the correct answers

details: Choose the correct answer checks comprehension as students identify the correct answer from three choices.
Look for correct identification and neat circling of the answers.
“What happened to Minh? Can you answer these questions to help me remember?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Homework Check:
Have Ss open to the previous lesson’s homework. Score completion %. Conduct activity feedback and error correction. Score achievement %. 
Project Gallery:
Check and encourage Ss to complete the project prompts so that they are ready to present by lesson 7,

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.71 - A. Read, write and number

details: Read, write and number checks comprehension of the story and practises accuracy. Write tests students’ ability to write a word or phrase correctly using clues and visuals.
Look for correct responses and neat completion of bookwork.
“Lien was looking sad too. Can you complete and order this story so we can find out what happened to her?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Homework Set:
Complete an example of the homework to check Ss understanding. Have Ss then write the homework page, activity and plan in their diaries. 
Leaderboard:
Show the Leaderboard and congratulate / encourage daily app practise.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.18 - C. Make your own story. Write, circle and stick. Act it out with your friend.

details: Make your own story gives students the opportunity to personalise a story by circling words or stickers. Students practise speaking by acting out the story.
Look for accurate word choice and sticker placement inside the story pictures. Also correct pronunciation and authentic intonation when acting out the story.
“Let’s make some magic and change Minh’s day. Who wants to help me out “

details: Listen and say practises the pronunciation of words with /ɜː/ and /ə/ at sentence level.
Look for clear pronunciation of words in the sentences and confident repetition.
